name: Healthcare Product Design
description: A project-based design course teaching the fundamentals of designing biomedical and healthcare devices and diagnostics. Educates students to solve real-life clinical problems using their engineering knowledge by designing and developing biomedical products ranging from devices, in-vitro diagnostic kits, and instruments. Project teams (3-4 students) work on a clinical problem identified by healthcare professionals. Case studies, hands-on prototyping, guest lectures from clinicians and MedTech start-up experts, discussions, and design reviews are used extensively. Includes coverage of regulatory, safety, and testing requirements and design control guidance.
